item.description: The next_token function has incomplete logic for handling various token types, particularly for incomplete tokens, literal strings, and hexadecimal strings. Tests show that incomplete tokens return None instead of proper types, and string boundaries aren't handled correctly.
item.contract: Function next_token(text, i=0) must correctly identify and return token types for all valid PDF syntax elements including integers, real numbers, booleans, keywords, names, strings, arrays, dictionaries, streams, and comments. For incomplete tokens (truncated input), it should return appropriate token type with correct boundaries or None if truly incomplete.

item.description: The parse_obj function lacks proper handling of nested structures and doesn't correctly parse dictionaries and arrays. The current implementation has logic gaps that prevent proper recursive parsing of nested objects.
item.contract: Function parse_obj(text, start=0) must correctly parse PDF objects including dictionaries, arrays, and nested structures. It should handle key-value pairs in dictionaries and elements in arrays recursively, properly converting token types to appropriate Python objects (bool, int, float, str, list, dict).
